# legacy_entrypoint

The oldest shape in the mycelia corpus: a session from before Claude Code recorded
`entrypoint`.

| | |
| --- | --- |
| Source session | `4b443ab7-98f8-4c1d-859f-9bdcafbabdd3` |
| Claude Code version | 1.0.128 |
| Records | the session's first two, in order |

Two of the 575 main transcripts in the corpus open on a `cwd`-bearing record with no
`entrypoint`; both are 1.0.128 sessions. The same records carry no `effort` and no
`attributionSkill`.

**Redaction.** Every `text`, `thinking`, `signature`, `content` and `summary` string is
replaced with `[redacted]`, and `gitBranch` is rewritten. Envelope fields — uuids, request
ids, timestamps, token counts — are the session's own, since they are what the test reads.
